text: At sunset, she reached the crystal waters of Daayaan.
Beside the reeds sat a frail old woman whose back was bent with centuries of age.
'Daughter,' the elder croaked with a parched voice, 'my head aches and my hair is tangled with dust.
Will you comb it for me?'
Kumba knelt in the sand with deep reverence.
She washed the elder's hair with cool river water, spoke words of comfort, and prepared a simple porridge with her dried baobab fruit, offering the first bite to the grandmother.
